## Problem and behavior

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant public issue
if one exists.

## Validation

List commands run and their results, including `npm run check`. Disclose any
checks that were skipped or could not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is small and focused, following [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).
- [ ] Tests cover applicable behavior changes.
- [ ] Applicable schemas, `openapi.yaml`, and documentation are consistent.
- [ ] Comments describe the current code.
- [ ] Examples and diagnostics contain no credentials or personal data.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for development and review expectations.
